name: Frontend Web Application
description: Framework- and package-manager-agnostic web application orchestration profile supporting component testing and browser automation.

tools.name: node
tools.description: Node.js runtime for bundler, typecheck, and test runner toolchains (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun selected by the repository).

tools.name: playwright
tools.description: Optional browser automation tool for E2E testing.

candidate_checks.description: Run build or static type checking using the actual script in the repository's package.json.
Run unit/component tests using the project's test runner.
Run UI interaction tests via browser automation (if configured by the project).

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the build/typecheck and test commands accepted by the repository
Scope verification of modified files and git diff --check output
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Implicit reliance on a package manager or framework that does not match the repository lockfile
Asynchronous UI state bugs (stale closures, data-fetching race conditions)
Exposing sensitive credentials or internal endpoints in the client-side bundle
Accessibility regressions and viewport/responsive layout issues
quant_escalation_required_when: Displaying or computing PnL formulas, funding rates, liquidation, margin, or risk metrics
